verdict.rationale: Devin has a Desktop app (docs.devin.ai/desktop) that imports VS Code/Cursor settings and an embedded IDE where users can 'follow and take over' Devin's process, implying some code/diff visibility, but the evidence never explicitly describes a visual diff viewer or the ability to run multiple sessions side by side within the desktop app. Missing for 10: explicit diff-view UI documentation, explicit multi-session side-by-side window/tab support in the desktop app, and any hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
